The timeout tie-break decides by how far the request got — no product frames and no log showing arrival would mean ENVIRONMENT_CONFIG, logs showing it arrived and was still processing would mean PRODUCT_DEFECT, and a too-short limit on a normally-slow operation would mean TEST_CODE_DEFECT — and nothing here distinguishes the three.
